# netbox_prefix (Data Source)

Retrieves a single prefix from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_prefix" "example" {
  prefix = "10.0.0.0/24"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cidr` (String) The cidr of the prefix. At least one of `description`, `family`, `prefix`, `vlan_vid`, `vrf_id`, `vlan_id`, `tenant_id`, `site_id`, `role_id`, `cidr`, `custom_fields`, `tag` or `status` must be given. Conflicts with `prefix`.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) Description to include in the data source filter. At least one of `description`, `family`, `prefix`, `vlan_vid`, `vrf_id`, `vlan_id`, `tenant_id`, `site_id`, `role_id`, `cidr`, `custom_fields`, `tag` or `status` must be given.
- `family` (Number) The IP family of the prefix. One of 4 or 6. At least one of `description`, `family`, `prefix`, `vlan_vid`, `vrf_id`, `vlan_id`, `tenant_id`, `site_id`, `role_id`, `cidr`, `custom_fields`, `tag` or `status` must be given.
- `prefix` (String) The prefix in CIDR notation. At least one of `description`, `family`, `prefix`, `vlan_vid`, `vrf_id`, `vlan_id`, `tenant_id`, `site_id`, `role_id`, `cidr`, `custom_fields`, `tag` or `status` must be given. Conflicts with `cidr`.
- `role_id` (Number) The ID of the role associated with the prefix. At least one of `description`, `family`, `prefix`, `vlan_vid`, `vrf_id`, `vlan_id`, `tenant_id`, `site_id`, `role_id`, `cidr`, `custom_fields`, `tag` or `status` must be given.
- `site_id` (Number) The ID of the site associated with the prefix. At least one of `description`, `family`, `prefix`, `vlan_vid`, `vrf_id`, `vlan_id`, `tenant_id`, `site_id`, `role_id`, `cidr`, `custom_fields`, `tag` or `status` must be given.
- `status` (String) The status of the prefix. At least one of `description`, `family`, `prefix`, `vlan_vid`, `vrf_id`, `vlan_id`, `tenant_id`, `site_id`, `role_id`, `cidr`, `custom_fields`, `tag` or `status` must be given.
- `tag` (String) Tag to include in the data source filter (must match the tag's slug). At least one of `description`, `family`, `prefix`, `vlan_vid`, `vrf_id`, `vlan_id`, `tenant_id`, `site_id`, `role_id`, `cidr`, `custom_fields`, `tag` or `status` must be given.
- `tag__n` (String) Tag to exclude from the data source filter (must match the tag's slug).
Refer to [Netbox's documentation](https://demo.netbox.dev/static/docs/rest-api/filtering/#lookup-expressions)
for more information on available lookup expressions.
- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant associated with the prefix. At least one of `description`, `family`, `prefix`, `vlan_vid`, `vrf_id`, `vlan_id`, `tenant_id`, `site_id`, `role_id`, `cidr`, `custom_fields`, `tag` or `status` must be given.
- `vlan_id` (Number) The ID of the vlan associated with the prefix. At least one of `description`, `family`, `prefix`, `vlan_vid`, `vrf_id`, `vlan_id`, `tenant_id`, `site_id`, `role_id`, `cidr`, `custom_fields`, `tag` or `status` must be given.
- `vlan_vid` (Number) The vlan vid of the prefix. At least one of `description`, `family`, `prefix`, `vlan_vid`, `vrf_id`, `vlan_id`, `tenant_id`, `site_id`, `role_id`, `cidr`, `custom_fields`, `tag` or `status` must be given.
- `vrf_id` (Number) The ID of the vrf associated with the prefix. At least one of `description`, `family`, `prefix`, `vlan_vid`, `vrf_id`, `vlan_id`, `tenant_id`, `site_id`, `role_id`, `cidr`, `custom_fields`, `tag` or `status` must be given.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the prefix.
- `location_id` (Number) The ID of the location associated with the prefix.
- `region_id` (Number) The ID of the region associated with the prefix.
- `site_group_id` (Number) The ID of the site group associated with the prefix.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
